newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Lepanto says Q1 net at 29.57 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Lepanto says Q1 net at 29.57 mln pesos.

text.p: Lepanto Consolidated Mining Co said on Monday it posted net income of 29.57 million pesos in the first quarter of the year.
Production from its new gold deposit in the northern Philippines, which began on March 16, boosted income. The company has yielded 527,000 ounces of gold since production began.
"For the whole year, we are projecting a net income of 648 million pesos," chairman Felipe Yap told stockholders.
He said the bulk of its revenue would come from gold sales extracted from the new mine.
The gold producer said its net income for 1996 stood at 45.7 million pesos, 62 percent lower than the previous year's level. ($1 = 26.35 pesos)
